roles.title: Senior Interior Designer
roles.summary: Lead corporate workplace projects from brief to handover, owning the design intent and the client relationship.
responsibilities: Run client workshops and turn briefs into space plans and concepts
Develop material palettes, joinery details and FF&E schedules
Guide junior designers and review drawings before issue
Visit site to resolve design queries during the build
requirements: Portfolio of delivered commercial or workplace interiors
Strong AutoCAD and SketchUp; Revit is a plus
Confident presenting to senior client stakeholders

roles.title: Junior Interior Designer
roles.summary: Support project teams on layouts, drawings and material selections while learning how great offices get built.
responsibilities: Prepare layouts, elevations and working drawings
Build mood boards and source samples
Update drawings from client and site feedback
requirements: Degree or diploma in interior design or architecture
Working knowledge of AutoCAD and SketchUp
A sharp eye for detail and a willingness to learn on site

roles.title: 3D Visualiser
roles.summary: Turn design concepts into photoreal stills and walkthroughs that help clients say yes.
responsibilities: Produce renders and animated walkthroughs for pitches and approvals
Build and maintain our material and furniture library
Work with designers to iterate quickly on lighting and finishes
requirements: A portfolio of interior renders with convincing lighting

roles.title: Project Manager — Fit-out
roles.summary: Own programme, budget and quality on our turnkey projects, and be the client's single point of contact.
responsibilities: Plan and track programmes, budgets and procurement
Coordinate contractors, MEP consultants and vendors
Run weekly client and site progress meetings
Lead snagging and handover documentation
requirements: Track record delivering commercial interior fit-outs
Solid grasp of civil, MEP and joinery sequencing

roles.title: Site Engineer
roles.summary: Keep our sites running safely and to drawing, every day.
responsibilities: Supervise daily site work and workforce
Check work against drawings and quality standards
Maintain site records, measurements and safety checks
requirements: Diploma or degree in civil engineering
Comfortable reading architectural and MEP drawings

roles.title: Business Development Executive
roles.summary: Find and win new corporate workplace projects and nurture long-term client relationships.
responsibilities: Identify and qualify leads across target sectors
Coordinate proposals and pitch presentations with the design team
Maintain the CRM and report on the pipeline
requirements: Experience selling to corporate or real-estate clients
Interest in design and the built environment
